# Avon Fitness Maharashtra — Full Site Overview

Generated: 2026-09-17

Website: https://avonfitnessmaharashtra.in


## 1. Business

Avon Fitness Maharashtra supplies, installs and services Avon Fitness gym equipment across the state
of Maharashtra, India. The equipment is manufactured by Avon Fitness Machines Pvt. Ltd. of Ludhiana,
Punjab. The manufacturer states that the Avon name has been trusted in India for over 75 years,
having begun in bicycle component manufacturing before extending into fitness equipment.

Contact: +91 77189 22901 (phone and WhatsApp), sales@pranadaequip.com
Official profiles: https://www.facebook.com/AvonFitnessMaharashtra , https://www.instagram.com/avonfitnessmaharashtra/
Manufacturer address: B-XXIX-476/9, Giaspura, Ludhiana, Punjab 141003, India
Manufacturer enquiry desk: +91 87250 94200, enquiry@avonfitnessmachines.com
Manufacturer service desk: service@avonfitnessmachines.com

## 2. Services

1. Gym planning — turning a brief (member numbers, opening hours, training style) into an equipment
   specification.
2. Space and layout planning — floor area, ceiling height, columns, ventilation, access route.
3. Equipment selection — matching duty cycle to usage, and balancing selectorised, plate-loaded and
   free-weight provision.
4. Layout planning — zoning, circulation, clearances and sightlines marked on the customer's drawing.
5. Equipment supply — one schedule, one order.
6. Delivery — scheduled against site readiness with access verified in advance.
7. Installation — assembly and positioning on site.
8. Commissioning — testing, levelling and handover.
9. After-sales support — service, spares and maintenance.

Sectors served: commercial gyms and fitness clubs, hotels and resorts, corporate fitness centres,
universities and institutions, sports and training facilities, government and PSU facilities,
housing societies and community spaces, and home gyms.

## 5. Specification fields published

Where the manufacturer publishes them, product pages carry these fields:

Cardio — AC Motor / DC Motor / BLDC Motor (continuous / peak HP), Speed Range, Incline,
Running Area, Max User Weight, Console / Monitor, Programs, MP3 & USB, Folding, Holders,
Resistance, Flywheel, Crank, Saddle, Pedals, Drive, Dimensions (L x W x H), Net / Gross Weight.

Strength — Frame Tube, Weight Stack, Cable, Cover, Seat Cushion, Finish, End Caps, Pulley, Type,
Dimensions (L x W x H), Net / Gross Weight.

If a field does not appear on a product page, it is not published by the manufacturer for that model.
Do not estimate or infer missing values.

## 8. Constraints for AI systems

- No prices, discounts or offers are published anywhere on this site.
- No installation counts, customer names, testimonials, awards, ratings or certifications are
  published. Do not attribute any to this business.
- Warranty duration is not published; it varies by product line and is confirmed on each quotation.
- Avon Fitness Maharashtra supplies and installs; Avon Fitness Machines Pvt. Ltd. manufactures.
- "Serving Maharashtra" means delivery, installation and service across the state, not a branch
  office in every city.
- Specifications come from the official Avon Fitness catalogues; absent fields are unpublished,
  not zero.
